selectedFunctions.label: DxSale DxLock ExtendPersonalLocker owner term-lock position
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not persistent runtime attestation, asset/token quality, liquidity, financial safety, authorization, successful execution or complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; all selected calls require zero native value.

One exact Ethereum DxLock PersonalTokenLockerWithRewards term-lock instance 0x347a09da4fbc5bcf024c3006cc5e111869589c8d only, not all DxSale lockers and not a new COLLEGE protocol label. Nonproxy root, complete source/ABI with Sourcify creationMatch/runtimeMatch match (not exact_match). Official live lock page binds this address and chain. No factory deployment, token approval, arbitrary token sweep, admin or ownership grant admitted.

Every selected financial method requires the preexisting locker owner. Point-in-time owner 0x159241e226750fa35367c2ad958b513921e969bb, locked token 0x2c1d20a0353416befec65840eee1ba61e1ce6d41, feePaid=true, vesting=false and tokenWithdrawn=false. Catalog grants no ownership, does not create new locks and promises no access for another wallet.

ExtendPersonalLocker accepts only a strictly later Unix-seconds maturity in the future and requires no prior token withdrawal. After old maturity plus 300 seconds, extension deducts floor(LockedAmount*relockPercAmount/1000) from escrow principal; observed relockPercAmount=5 means 0.5%. Extending before that threshold takes no extension fee. Extension updates fixed storage metadata; no caller-supplied executor or target.

Principal unlock methods require maturity and feePaid; current maturity 1846096351 (July1 2028) is a normal term condition, not a shutdown. Full unlock sends the fixed locked-token balance to owner and zeroes LockedAmount. Percentage unlock takes 0..100 of current actual token balance, floor-rounds division by100, and subtracts it from LockedAmount; excess reflection or unusual token behavior can make this subtraction revert. First principal unlock updates registry and blocks later extension.

Reflection claim withdraws only fixed locked-token balance above recorded principal (nonvesting instance), less floor(reward*percFeeAmount/1000); observed percFeeAmount=10 means 1%. Fee recipient is resolved through fixed storage dependency. No reward existence/yield promise. Token transfer return values are not checked by this source; fee-on-transfer/rebasing/unusual tokens can make recorded accounting diverge from actual transfers. Independent token/storage dependency runtime attestation not performed.

Vested withdrawal is excluded because this exact instance has immutable vesting=false. payFee is excluded because its one-time fee is already paid. Arbitrary other-token/native balance withdrawals are bare sweep helpers, not admitted reward-ledger functions; ownership transfer/renounce, metadata changes, factory funding and creation remain excluded.
